egress: No level blocks requests to the model provider: what you type still goes to the configured model. Use a local provider for that.

levels.name: Off
levels.label: L0 — Off
levels.description: Standard behaviour: conversations are saved and synced, the knowledge base is used, the audit line is written.

withholds.retrieval: Knowledge-base and memory context are injected as usual.
withholds.memory: Memories are extracted after qualifying turns and verified facts are promoted.
withholds.server: Conversations are saved and synced; verification reports, verified facts and claim feedback are stored.
withholds.browser: Conversations are cached in this browser's local storage.
withholds.audit: The MCP tool-call audit line is written.
withholds.egress: The request goes to the configured model provider.

levels.name: Skip saves & sync
levels.label: L1 — Skip saves & sync
levels.description: Nothing from this conversation is saved, synced or turned into memories. The knowledge base is still used and the model still receives what you type.

withholds.retrieval: Unchanged: knowledge-base and memory context are still injected.
withholds.memory: Withheld: memory extraction and verified-fact promotion return without storing anything.
withholds.server: Withheld: conversation saves, sync and deletes are refused; verification reports are not written to Redis or Neo4j; SDK claim feedback is dropped.
withholds.browser: Withheld: the conversation is held in memory only, never written to local storage, and is gone on reload.
withholds.audit: Unchanged: the MCP tool-call audit line is written.
withholds.egress: Not blocked: the chat still goes to the configured provider. Under the hybrid or cloud-first profile, internal pipeline stages pinned to the cloud run on the local provider instead.

levels.name: Also skip the knowledge base
levels.label: L2 — Also skip the knowledge base
levels.description: Also no knowledge-base or memory context: the model sees only what you type. The request to the model itself is still sent.

withholds.retrieval: Withheld: no knowledge-base or memory context reaches the model. The server strips injected context from chat and SDK completions; KB search, memory recall and wiki enrichment return empty.
withholds.memory: Withheld: memory extraction and verified-fact promotion return without storing anything.
withholds.server: Withheld: conversation saves, sync and deletes are refused; verification reports are not written to Redis or Neo4j; SDK claim feedback is dropped.
withholds.browser: Withheld: the conversation is held in memory only, never written to local storage, and is gone on reload.
withholds.audit: Unchanged: the MCP tool-call audit line is written.
withholds.egress: Not blocked: what you type still goes to the configured provider.

levels.name: Also skip the audit line
levels.label: L3 — Also skip the audit line
levels.description: Also no MCP tool-call audit line. Metrics counters, the enterprise audit log and ordinary server logs are still written.

withholds.retrieval: Withheld: no knowledge-base or memory context reaches the model. The server strips injected context from chat and SDK completions; KB search, memory recall and wiki enrichment return empty.
withholds.memory: Withheld: memory extraction and verified-fact promotion return without storing anything.
withholds.server: Withheld: conversation saves, sync and deletes are refused; verification reports are not written to Redis or Neo4j; SDK claim feedback is dropped.
withholds.browser: Withheld: the conversation is held in memory only, never written to local storage, and is gone on reload.
withholds.audit: Withheld: the MCP tool-call audit line (mcp.tool_call) is not written. Still recorded: metrics counters in Redis, the enterprise audit log and ordinary server logs.
withholds.egress: Not blocked: what you type still goes to the configured provider.

levels.name: Full ephemeral
levels.label: L4 — Full ephemeral
levels.description: As L3, and when the last L4 tab closes Private Mode switches itself off. Nothing from the session was saved to begin with.

withholds.retrieval: Withheld: no knowledge-base or memory context reaches the model. The server strips injected context from chat and SDK completions; KB search, memory recall and wiki enrichment return empty.
withholds.memory: Withheld: memory extraction and verified-fact promotion return without storing anything.
withholds.server: Withheld as at L1. When an L4 tab closes, the browser asks the server to forget that tab's private conversations permanently, with whatever memories and verified facts they produced before the tab reached L4, and keeps a receipt. When the last L4 tab closes the level resets to 0. Cached query results are not wiped; they expire on their own.
withholds.browser: Withheld: the conversation is held in memory only, never written to local storage, and is gone on reload.
withholds.audit: Withheld: the MCP tool-call audit line (mcp.tool_call) is not written. Still recorded: metrics counters in Redis, the enterprise audit log and ordinary server logs.
withholds.egress: Not blocked: what you type still goes to the configured provider.
